title: Obscure Revival
description: This mod aims to refine unpopular elements,making them truly shine when it's there time to take the stage.
body:
"Not all brilliance is born to shine. Some only need a new stage."

Obscure Revival(Not affiliated with Obscure Tooltips / Obscure API. It is a completely independent project.) is a Minecraft mod dedicated to unearthing forgotten, overlooked, and underutilized elements of the game—and giving them a stage to truly shine.

--- **Currently available:** Chainmail Armor Redux — a complete rework that makes chainmail scale in protection the longer you survive in combat. Fully stable, tested, and ready for your survival world. --- ## ⚔️ Chainmail Armor Redux ✅ Chainmail now specializes in slash-deflection defense. Its protection value grows dynamically the longer you survive a fight — rewarding endurance over brute force. ![Keloid-Enchanted Chainmail: Armor Grows When Hit](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bb53a2d2e967254292623fa7391ce7abbb4b221d.jpeg) **✅ Status: Complete & Stable** - Fully functional in singleplayer and multiplayer - Network-synchronized via Minecraft's official tracked data system - No known bugs --- ## 🚧 What's Next (Coming in Future Updates) These features are planned but not yet available. Follow development on GitHub! - 🫧 Echo Shards: Warden-counter mechanics - 🏹 Fletching Table: Full GUI rework - 🗺️ Dynamic Cartography: Structure-hinting maps --- ## 📥 Installation
Click to expand 1. Ensure you have **Fabric Loader 0.18.4+** installed for Minecraft 1.21.11. 2. Download the latest `.jar` from this page. 3. Place it into your `.minecraft/mods` folder. 4. **Important:** This mod must be installed on **both the client and the server** to function correctly. > **Currently, this mod has no required dependencies.** If this changes, they will be clearly listed here.
--- ## 📜 Usage Policy
Click to expand ### 🤝 What You CAN Do - ✅ **Share this mod freely.** You are welcome to share the original `.jar` file in non-commercial modpacks, on forums, or with friends—as long as you give proper credit and link back to this page. - ✅ **Soft-depend on this mod.** Other mods may reference Obscure Revival's mod ID, use its APIs (if any), or offer complementary features that enhance the experience—without copying or redistributing our code or assets. - ✅ **Non-commercial modpacks:** You may include this mod in any non-commercial modpack. Telling me about it would make my day, but it's never required. ### 🚫 What You CANNOT Do - ❌ **No plagiarism or copying.** You may not copy, clone, or substantially reproduce any part of this mod's code or assets in your own projects. - ❌ **No derivative works.** You may not modify, adapt, remix, or transform this mod and redistribute it. This project currently does not support adaptation by other authors. - ❌ **No commercial use.** You may not use this mod, or any part of it, for any commercial purpose. --- ## ⚠️ Disclaimer
Click to expand I'm a university student, and modding is a passion project for me. **Academics always come first.** Maintenance may be inconsistent, and updates may be slow. Thank you for your patience and understanding.
--- ## 🤝 Contributing - **Revival Proposals:** Have a forgotten item or mechanic you'd love to see revived? Open an Issue on [GitHub](你的GitHub仓库链接) with `[Revival Proposal]` in the title. - **Bug Reports:** Please include your `latest.log` file and clear steps to reproduce. - **Translations:** Want to help translate Obscure Revival into your language? Pull Requests are warmly welcomed.
